title: Calibration Roadrunner: smoke runner for quant rollouts using weighted query profiles
creator: Marcus Liu
description: Goal: Build an automated smoke/acceptance runner ("Roadrunner") that validates FP8/INT8 quantization profiles via calibrated replays of weighted query profiles and a curated reference prompt set (the 'gold set'). This ticket covers: 1) ingesting production-weighted query profiles, 2) driving calibration workflows to produce quant profiles, 3) running deterministic golden-prompt replays across candidate quant variants, and 4) evaluating multi-cohort pass/fail gates before allowing canary rollouts. The runner must be lightweight, fast (target <6 hours end-to-end for a typical model), and integrate with the release pipeline and rollback policies.
updates: 2026-03-01: Spike complete — validated approach for weighted query sampling: stratify by endpoint, sequence-length bucket, and token-entropy quartile.
2026-03-05: Prototype ingestion connector implemented for query profiles (S3 path: s3://prod-weighted-queries/2026-03). Saved as artifact for replay harness.
2026-03-09: Calibration workflow sketch reviewed with ML infra. Decided to use two-pass calibration: global histogram + per-layer scale refinement.
2026-03-12: First smoke run of Roadrunner against fp8_candA and int8_cand1 completed. Collected metrics; initial failure on long-form summarization cohort (ROUGE-L delta 1.8%).

2026-03-14: Added adaptive golden-curation to upweight failing cohorts for subsequent calibration iterations. Created PR #1267 with the harness runner and telemetry hooks (github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1267).
acceptance_criteria: Runner ingests weighted query profiles and can produce per-cohort sampling summaries (endpoint, length, entropy).
Calibration workflow produces deployable quant profile artifacts (metadata + provenance) for FP8 and INT8 candidates.
Automated replay executes golden-prompt set and cohort-sampled queries against baseline fp32 and candidate quant variants and stores token-level deltas.
Pass/fail gates applied automatically: if any cohort exceeds configured metric deltas, the candidate is marked FAIL and a human review ticket is created.
Smoke-run latency: full run for standard model (avg seq len 128, 20k sampled queries + 500 gold prompts) completes within 6 hours on dedicated CI hardware.
Integration: passing run emits release artifact and tags canary policy to allow 0.5% traffic rollout; failing run blocks release and notifies oncall.
Run artifacts are recorded in storage with clear provenance (query snapshot id, calibration seed, kernel/version).
runbook: Step 1: Upload weighted query profile snapshot and verify sample coverage in S3 path.
Step 2: Kick off Roadrunner job via CI (./tools/roadrunner/run.sh --snapshot <id> --candidates fp8_candA,int8_cand1).
Step 3: Monitor Grafana panels for per-cohort deltas; expect numerical metrics to be populated within first hour.
Step 4: If a candidate FAILs, review cohort-level diffs and file follow-up ENG ticket with failing prompt examples.
Step 5: For PASS, verify artifact signed and roll forward canary policy; watch SLOs during 24-hour canary window.
evaluation_metrics: Per-cohort ROUGE-L delta (candidate vs fp32): fail if > 1.0% absolute for long-form summarization cohort.
Semantic-similarity (embedding cosine) mean delta: fail if mean drops > 0.015 from baseline.
Token-likelihood mean drop: fail if average log-likelihood decreases by > 0.002 per token.
Top-1 response agreement on classification/coherence probes: fail if agreement drops > 0.8 percentage points.
Latency regression: fail if median per-token latency increases > 15% for common sequence-length buckets.
Stability probe (stochastic replays): fail if response variance increases > 25% for a cohort.
Overall gate: fail if any critical cohort is failing OR 3+ non-critical cohorts fail simultaneously.
